tables.name: t
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * {n} + {i} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

params.query: SELECT sum(u1) FROM {db}.t WHERE k BETWEEN 40000 AND 120000

description: Hold-out on cas_cached: three Wide parts of the narrow shape (70 000 rows each); restart, one pass of SELECT sum(u1) that fills the cache, then the measured pass.
